name: Hotpoint HDE6VDCASB1 — 60cm Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Hotpoint HDE6VDCASB1 is a 60cm freestanding electric cooker in black with a dedicated Air Fry programme and a 75L Multiflow main oven plus a 38L top oven (up to 126L). A fast-heating ceramic hob with a flexible double-ring zone and SteamAssist baking round it off, with catalytic liners for easy cleaning. A energy rated, 10-year parts guarantee.
features: Dedicated Air Fry programme — little to no oil
Ceramic hob with flexible double-ring zone
SteamAssist for lighter pastries & golden crusts
